description: Figure 6 presents the distribution of data source in combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets, visualized as a pie chart. The chart contains five slices, representing the categories HOTPOTQA (24.2%), ENTITYQA (20.6%), TRIVIA (6.8%), TREC (5.6%), and WEBOESTO (3.6%). The chart includes a legend labeling each slice with its corresponding category. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, indicating the proportion of each data source. The slices appear ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is a visual observation only.
